notFound.title: This page isn't here
notFound.body: The address is out of date or has a typo.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: This page didn't load correctly. The error is on our side — try again in a moment.
wizard.optionalHint: This step is optional — “{label}” works when empty too.
voice.micDenied: The browser can't access the microphone. Allow it in the site settings (the lock icon next to the address).
voice.noMic: No microphone found. Connect one and try again.
voice.micFailed: Couldn't turn on the microphone. Try again.
voice.notRecognized: Couldn't recognize the recording. Try again.
voice.noSpeech: No speech in the recording. Speak closer to the microphone and try again.
voice.offline: No connection — the recording wasn't processed. Try again.
voice.tooLong: The recording is too long. Record a shorter part.
voice.recording: Recording — up to {minutes} min. The text will appear when you finish.
voice.notEnabled: Dictation isn't enabled in this browser yet. Try Chrome or Edge.
voice.tooMany: Too many recordings in a short time. Try again in a minute.
voice.unreadable: Couldn't read the recording. Try again.
voice.empty: The recording is empty. Try again.
voice.serviceDown: The speech recognition service isn't responding. Try again shortly.
voice.quota: The temporary dictation limit has been reached. Try again in a minute.
error.appBody: This page didn't load correctly. The error is on our side, not yours — your saved answers are safe.
notFound.appBody: It may have been deleted or it belongs to a team you're not in right now. Check that the right team is selected in the menu.
